prompt: Provide an overview of relational databases. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Every sentence must contain exactly eight words. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Do not use any lowercase letters; the entire response must be in UPPERCASE.
evaluation_criteria:
Sentence Length: 0-5 (Evaluates exact eight words per sentence)
Uppercase Rule: 0-5 (Evaluates ALL CAPS formatting)
response_text:
RELATIONAL DATABASES ALWAYS STORE VALUABLE DATA IN TABLES. 

THESE TABLES CONTAIN MANY ORGANIZED ROWS AND COLUMNS. 

UNIQUE PRIMARY KEYS ALWAYS IDENTIFY EACH INDIVIDUAL ROW. 

FOREIGN KEYS WILL CONVENIENTLY LINK THESE DIFFERENT TABLES. 

USERS QUERY THE DATA USING STRUCTURED QUERY LANGUAGE. 

THESE SYSTEMS ENSURE HIGH DATA INTEGRITY AND CONSISTENCY.
